title: Mining Laser
description: The &3Mining Laser&r is a laser drill which can be used to quickly dig large areas. It has a &e100MHE&r internal power buffer and a 64,000mB internal &bCrude Oil&r buffer. Its default radius is 3, which can be increased by the use of an effectiveness upgrade. It can also be equiped with various upgrades to unlock new functions such as shredding or voiding.
